rationale.edition: The authoritative changed-files list contains only web/src/... paths (web/src/components/alerts/PipelinesDestinationList.vue and its .spec.ts). No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) are touched and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/etc.) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (no tests-added label and the trigger comment is empty), and the change alters a user-exercisable UI flow (the pipeline destination editor open/close behavior), so it is user-facing.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the fix changes a user-facing UI interaction: the destination editor must remain open when adding/editing a destination even if a late getDestinations() response arrives, and the route query action must correctly map to add/update.
rationale.area: The changed component lives in web/src/components/alerts/, and sibling destination specs (e.g. alerts-destinations-prebuilt.spec.js) live under the Alerts testfolder, so the Alerts area fits.
rationale.group: The Alerts testfolder shard exists across the ci-matrix files and already carries destination-related specs (alerts-destinations-prebuilt.spec.js, alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js), making it the closest existing shard for this spec.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only changed test file (web/src/components/alerts/PipelinesDestinationList.spec.ts) is a Vitest unit test, which is not E2E coverage and does not set existing_tests_in_diff.
